instructions: Voice: confident, warm, professional American English narrator for a premium technology product film. Pace: measured and clear, with natural pauses at commas. Tone: assured and modern, never salesy or over-excited.

lines.text: But disconnected data, inconsistent customer experiences, and inventory challenges still slow businesses down.
RetailPulse AI turns natural-language requests into personalized recommendations, grounded in real product data and store availability.
Ask for a laptop for Java development, under ₹80,000, that you can pick up today.
lines.speak: Ask for a laptop for Java development, under eighty thousand rupees, that you can pick up today.

lines.text: The assistant turns your words into filters, ranks only real products from the catalog, and pulls live prices and stock straight from the database.
Answers are grounded in approved retail policies, with traceable sources: the document, the section, and the version.
Retrieval filters by country, membership tier, and effective date, so customers only see the rules that apply to them.
And when the evidence is missing, RetailPulse says so clearly, with safeguards instead of guesses.
From inventory insights to support workflows, AI proposes actions, while secure backend controls enforce permissions and confirmation.
A cracked screen becomes a high-priority support ticket, created only when the customer presses Confirm.
Store managers get low-stock alerts and approve AI-proposed stock updates, scoped to their own store.
And every proposal, confirmation, and denial lands in an append-only audit trail.
One modular platform: React, FastAPI, and PostgreSQL with pgvector, with every AI output validated on the server.
lines.speak: One modular platform: React, Fast A.P.I., and Postgres with P.G. vector, with every AI output validated on the server.

lines.text: Smarter shopping. Connected operations. AI you can trust.
